model_details.name: MobileNetV3-Small Lettuce Health Classifier (Exp_A_EndToEnd_Weighted)
model_details.selection_protocol: Selected strictly on validation macro-F1 without test leakage

intended_use.purpose: Educational college demo for lettuce nutrient deficiency screening.
unsupported_uses: Synthetic AI-generated images (model was trained on real plant photos and will misclassify DALL-E art).
Multimodal soil inference (soil is provisional rule-based).

critical_limitations: Valid set Healthy class has 211 images from 1 longitudinal cohort; balanced metrics were used to prevent bias.
Deficiency images are sourced from greenhouse hydroponics (16 N groups, 19 P groups, 15 K groups).
Outdoor field photographs under diverse solar angles may experience domain shift.
Synthetic DALL-E images cannot be diagnosed reliably by this model.
